name: Dates sorted chronologically
detail: 2879 sessions from 2015-01-02 to 2026-09-10 are strictly increasing.

name: Target equals next-day movement
detail: Independent recomputation of 1[Close(t+1) > Close(t)] matches all 2878 labels; the final row's label is undefined (NaN).

name: Final unlabeled row excluded
detail: 2026-09-10 has no next close and is absent from the modeling data.

name: No look-ahead constructs in feature code
detail: Syntax-tree scan of features.py and baselines.py found no negative shift, centred window, backward fill or interpolation; 1 shift(periods) call(s) take a variable lag, which trailing_return() restricts to positive values and the truncation test verifies numerically.

name: Features unchanged when the future is removed
detail: All 14 features recomputed on 40 truncated histories; largest absolute difference = 0.0e+00.

name: Target and next-day columns excluded from features
detail: Neither feature set contains Target, Next_Close, Next_Date or the Persistence helper columns.

name: No NaN or infinite values in model inputs
detail: 2233 train and 558 test rows x 14 features are all finite.

name: Train period ends before test period
Every training label resolved before the test window
detail: Latest Close(t+1) used by a training label is from 2024-06-04; 1 embargo row(s) purged.

name: Chronological split, no shuffling
detail: Train + embargo + test reproduce the original date order exactly; no random split is used.

name: Scaler fitted on training rows only (Raw OHLCV)
detail: StandardScaler saw 2233 rows (= training rows) and its Close mean 12,876.7 equals the training mean, not the train+test mean 15,197.5.

name: Scaler fitted on training rows only (Engineered Features)
detail: StandardScaler saw 2233 rows (= training rows) and its Close mean 12,876.7 equals the training mean, not the train+test mean 15,197.5.

name: Hyper-parameter search never sees the test set
detail: All 5 TimeSeriesSplit folds (gap = 1) index only the 2233 training rows, and each validation block starts after its fitting block ends.

name: Majority class taken from training labels
detail: Training UP share 53.92% -> predict UP. (The test-set majority, UP, was not used.)

name: Persistence uses only information up to day t
detail: Persistence(t) = 1[Close(t) > Close(t-1)] recomputed independently for every test day; it matches the realised next-day label on 54.1% of days (a rule that could see tomorrow would match 100%).

name: All four approaches scored on the same test days
detail: Persistence, Majority Class, Raw OHLCV, Engineered Features each predict the same 558 sessions (2024-06-05 to 2026-09-09).

name: Comparison table reproduces from saved predictions
detail: Accuracy in four_way_comparison.csv equals the accuracy recomputed from test_predictions.csv for all 4 approaches.

name: Prediction plot drawn from actual test predictions
detail: The 558 predictions plotted equal a fresh pipeline.predict() on the test features, in chronological order.
